transcript.content: Hello, what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... I've just gotten so slowed down lately. I'm an accountant, and I'll sit there staring at one single audit workpaper for maybe twenty minutes before I even move my hand to type a number. It's like I just can't get my body to do it. And, um, people at work have started noticing that I'm not keeping up with my usual pace.
Have you noticed your hands shaking when they are relaxed and not being used?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. My hands don't really shake when they're just resting. It's more just that slowness I mentioned, like they're too heavy to move when I want them to, but there's no shaking.
Have you noticed stiffness in your muscles?

No, I haven't really noticed any stiffness. My muscles don't feel tight or hard to bend or anything like that. It's really just that heavy feeling I was talking about, where it just takes a lot of effort to actually get them moving.
Have you been feeling persistently sad or depressed lately?

Yes, I have. Um... most days I just wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling right in my chest. It honestly feels like the day is already lost before I've even managed to get out of bed. It's just been really hard to shake.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?

Yes, I have. I used to really like planning hikes, taking photos, cooking big meals on Sundays, and volunteering at the local library. But lately... I just don't care about any of it. They just feel like items on a checklist now, and I don't even have the energy or desire to start them.
Have you ever had a previous period in your life when you felt depressed and lost interest in activities for at least two weeks?

No, I don't think so. I've had times where I was stressed or, you know, maybe down for a few days, but nothing like this. This has been going on for a while now, and it's definitely the first time it's been this bad or lasted this long.
Have there been times when you were awake but unable to move or respond to people around you?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I can always move and respond, even if I don't really want to.
